create_PatchTSTConfig: create a PatchTSTConfig instance with custom prediction_length and context_length for time-series forecasting
build_PatchTSTModel_from_config: build a PatchTSTModel using a PatchTSTConfig instance for initializing random weights
configure_PatchTST_pretraining: configure PatchTSTConfig with masking parameters for random or forecast pretraining
access_PatchTST_model_config: access the model configuration from an instantiated PatchTSTModel via model.config
configure_PatchTST_distribution_head: configure PatchTSTConfig with distribution_output and loss for student_t, normal, or negative_binomial emission heads
